```python
import polars as pl

# Create sample long-format DataFrame
df_long = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-03", "2024-01-03"],
    "city": ["New York", "Los Angeles", "New York", "Los Angeles", "New York", "Los Angeles"],
    "temperature": [32, 65, 35, 68, 38, 72]
})

# Reshape to wide format (one row per date, one column per city)
df_wide = df_long.pivot(index="date", columns="city", values="temperature")

print(df_wide)
```
